intro: Use this guide after you have delivered Kora's implementation and logged the 20 tests, or when reviewing someone else's. Score each area against evidence (documents, logs, screenshots, test results), not descriptions. A win needs 80 points or more and every must-have in the go-live check passing; one missing must-have fails the build whatever the score.

rows.full: Process map with leaks turned into requirements; musts at most half; numeric success measures; data audit with duplicates and active counts; dated plan recommendation; a design (objects, dictionary, pipelines with exit rules, permission matrix, assignment rules) complete enough for someone else to rebuild, within plan limits; signed.
rows.partial: Documents exist but one part is weak: success measures not numeric, dictionary missing types or values, or plan limits not checked.
rows.low: No signed requirements or design, or the build doesn't follow them.

rows.full: Mapping for every column; scripted cleaning reusable on the delta; rejects with reasons; strong-key de-duplication with a review queue; external IDs; test loads; reconciliation with zero differences (test 14); freeze, delta and written rollback trigger.
rows.partial: Data loads correctly but cleaning was manual, or reconciliation was by eye, or there's no rollback plan.
rows.low: Duplicates, missing associations or merges on names; re-runs create new records.

rows.full: Routing on facts with existing-owner first, team rotation among available agents and re-route timer (tests 1, 4–8); single, owned follow-ups and stuck alerts (9–10); lost reason required (11); no loops; switched on for new records; register complete.
rows.partial: Routing works but a branch is untested, or alerts can repeat, or the register is incomplete.
rows.low: Leads unowned or double-owned, task floods, or loops.

rows.full: Idempotent upsert-enquiry with event IDs (test 2); form webhook secret (3); portal parser with alerts and daily count check; WhatsApp only to opted-in contacts via template (16); Paystack verified by signature and API, matched by reference, never sets Won (17–18); integration log.
rows.partial: Integrations work but one safeguard is missing: no idempotency, no daily count, or matching by amount.
rows.low: Secrets in the browser, forged events accepted, or messages outside WhatsApp's rules.

rows.full: Permission matrix proven with test users (12) and export restricted (13); commissions, IDs and bank details kept out; least-privilege tokens; the agent has no tool that deletes, changes access or moves money.
rows.partial: Permissions configured but not proven by tests, or one sensitive field kept without justification.
rows.low: Agents can see or export everyone's records, or sensitive data is stored freely.

rows.full: UAT scripts for every must-have with results; defects vs change requests separated; role-based training with videos and champions; three dashboards with stated decisions; four weekly adoption reports with targets and actions; handover pack and two client admins.
rows.partial: Training and dashboards exist but adoption isn't measured over time, or handover is incomplete.
rows.low: No UAT, a feature-tour training, or the client can't run the CRM without you.

rows.full: Read-only tools; plans with dry run and hash; Telegram approval; separate apply workflow with verification and change log; injection and hash tests pass (19–20); a monthly health report with numbers from tools and ranked actions.
rows.partial: Agent works but apply is inside the agent, or verification or change log is missing.
rows.low: The agent can change the CRM without approval, or invents numbers.

rows.full: Short-lets handled as a signed change request with impact; personal-clients sheet resolved with the owner and agent using permissions, no secret migration; Ibadan adoption diagnosed by office with numbers and a follow-up measurement.
rows.low: Curveballs ignored or handled by quietly changing scope or data.

evidence: Signed requirements document and solution design (client names may stay: Kora is fictional)
Mapping sheet, cleaning workflow export and reconciliation log
Automation register and n8n workflow exports (no credentials)
Integration log extract and the 20-test log with results
Screenshots of the permission tests with two test users
UAT results, training plan and links to three training videos
Dashboards (screenshots) and four weekly adoption reports
Agent change log and the first health report, plus a 5-minute demo video
mistakes: Building before the design is signed, then fixing it in production.
Migration that can't be re-run safely because there's no external ID.
Automations tested only on the happy path.
Payments matched by name or amount, or allowed to set Won.
Adoption treated as finished on launch day.
An agent with an admin token and a general API tool.
